Subject: Draft start: Velvet activation milestones and owners

Mina / Ben —

Quick note to kick off the activation plan discussion for Velvet Health. Carlos and I walked through high-level goals yesterday; they want a tight 8-week initial activation focusing on chat triage and embedding search.

I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (Velvet_MAR_v0) with proposed milestones, owners, and target dates. Can you both review and flag anything you think is optimistic? Key asks from Velvet:
- Production demo with SSO + data filtering by 2026-05-01
- SOC2 evidence requested by procurement this week (I've asked them to send the checklist)

Next step: refine owners + delivery dates into a single timeline we can share with the customer by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0183

Attachment: Velvet_MAR_v0.xlsx (spreadsheet: milestones / owners / comments)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Carlos Rojas <c.rojas@velvethealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft start: Velvet activation milestones and owners

Thanks Marissa — skimmed the sheet. A couple of technical clarifications before we lock dates:

1) SSO integration: if they already have Okta and are willing to provision a test app this week, we can schedule an SSO dry-run with them in week 1 and prod cutover in week 3. Otherwise add 2 weeks to the SSO line.
2) Data access: for embeddings work we need a scoped s3 read-only bucket and a small sample dataset (5k docs). Request that from their infra by 2026-04-09.
3) Load testing: propose a mid-sprint load test during week 4 to validate batching settings — I can run that with their staging traffic if they provide a load profile.

I've annotated the attached with technical dependencies and risk flags. I'll also prepare a one-page tech checklist for the customer (will attach).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Velvet_MAR_v0_technical_notes.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Rojas <c.rojas@velvethealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft start: Velvet activation milestones and owners

Carlos — thanks for the intro and for sharing Velvet's priorities. I pulled together a customer-facing MAP that maps milestones to clear owners, acceptance criteria, and contingency windows (attached). Top-level proposal:

- Week 0 (2026-04-07 to 2026-04-13): Kickoff + SSO test app provisioning (Owner: Velvet infra / Carlos)
- Week 1 (2026-04-14 to 2026-04-20): Data ingest + embeddings proof-of-concept (Owner: Ben / Velvet data)
- Week 3 (2026-04-28 to 2026-05-04): Production demo with SSO and RBAC filters (Owner: Marissa / Mina)
- Week 4 (2026-05-05 to 2026-05-11): Load validation + tuning (Owner: Ben)
- Week 6 (2026-05-19 to 2026-05-25): Adoption check-in + rollback criteria defined (Owner: Mina
)

Acceptance criteria examples (attached in MAP): working SSO login as an org admin, embeddings similarity > 0.78 on validation set, average API p95 latency < 300ms. If any of the acceptance checks fail, we use the contingency windows indicated in the sheet.

Carlos — action items for your team to move forward:
- Share Okta admin contact + set up test app by 2026-04-09
- Provision read-only bucket with 5k document sample by 2026-04-09
- Procurement to confirm SOC2 evidence checklist (procurement@velvethealth.com) — we will compile and send back the required artifacts.

I attached Velvet_MAP_v1.xlsx (customer-facing) and SOC2-evidence-request.pdf to help procurement. Please confirm by EOD Monday if the timeline looks feasible.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: Velvet_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

Subject: Re: Velvet Health — Activation Plan & Responsibility Timeline

Thanks Mina — the timeline looks reasonable. Quick confirmations from our side:

- I'll loop in Okta admin (Karen) to provision a test app — Karen, can you take this one? Target: 2026-04-09.
- Procurement will review the SOC2 doc and respond with a checklist/next steps by 2026-04-07.
- I'll ask data infra to stage the sample bucket; we aim to have it ready by 2026-04-09.

Two asks from Velvet:
1) Can Redwood provide a short onboarding playbook for our internal ops team (1–2 pages) that summarizes runbook steps and rollback triggers?
2) For the production demo, can we schedule two possible windows (2026-04-29 morning PT or 2026-04-30 afternoon PT)?

If those are OK, we'll confirm times and Karen will handle Okta.

—Carlos
Head of Product | Velvet Health
c.rojas@velvethealth.com
